structured_output.summary: The finding is real. `steerTo` in tests/sim/rival-pickup-block.test.ts:12-18 duplicates `driveToward` from tests/sim/helpers.ts. It uses the same heading formula, wrap, gain of 2.5 and clamp, and only the wrap differs, at exactly ±π. But the only way to remove the duplicate is to edit tests/sim/rival-pickup-block.test.ts, and that test file already exists. My rules allow only src/** (not src/driver/**) and new files under tests/**, and forbid editing any existing test. Nothing under src/ causes the duplicate, so I couldn't fix it within the allowed files. I changed nothing. The cleanup is safe: delete `steerTo` and the now-unused `CarView`/`PickupInstance` type imports, import `driveToward` from './helpers.ts', and use `driveToward(world, box.x, box.z).steer`. Whoever is allowed to edit tests should apply it.
